purpose: Ties festivals.json (Ramadan, Eid) to approximate Gregorian dates so seasonal content is scheduled correctly each year without manual recalculation. Hijri dates shift ~10-11 days earlier each Gregorian year — this file must be re-verified and extended annually, not treated as permanently fixed.
note: Dates are astronomical-projection estimates (Umm al-Qura calendar basis), sourced from multiple current Islamic-calendar publishers as of 2026-08-01. Actual observance depends on local moon sighting and can shift by 1-2 days. Confirm against a current source close to the date before finalizing production scheduling.

schedule.source_note: Multiple 2026-verified sources converge on Feb 7-8, 2027 for the start of Ramadan 1448 AH
Estimated range across sources is March 9-11, 2027, depending on whether Ramadan completes 29 or 30 days

update_instructions: Extend this table one year ahead once the current year's dates pass, or when topic_planner.md finds it's within 30 days of a festival with no schedule entry beyond the current table. Do not extrapolate future years by simply subtracting ~11 days without verifying against a current source at the time — the pattern is a useful estimate, not a substitute for confirmation.
